testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_requirement: EVERY interactive element (buttons, tabs, filter inputs, cards, links, modals, chat toggles, compare checkboxes, login triggers) MUST include a explicit role-based data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_rules: All normal text must meet minimum 4.5:1 WCAG AA contrast against backgrounds. Never use fully transparent dark text over dark images without solid gradient backing.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where appropriate, avoiding heavy muddy glass.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add .App { text-align: center; } in CSS files.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc. for icons. Use lucide-react or phosphor icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All JS code files must be created as .js or .jsx as configured in the codebase.
All interactive elements MUST include explicit data-testid attributes.
